items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...do you remember Big Eye Louie? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, he's one of the clarinets that I play.

ctx.x: Yeah, we played blues, but played in a modern way, you know. They didn't, you know. Now, I'll tell you what, they're playing the blues in churches now in a way.
The style they're playing is a blues style. Oh, I was going to ask, do you remember Big Eye Louie? Oh, yeah. How did he play clarinet?
Oh, he's one of the clarinets that I play.
